description: Public website image scheduling and responsive image hints only; no design changes.

carousel.priority: Desktop collectionIndex uses the collection Item Index. Framer's responsive export does not forward that virtual binding on mobile/tablet; these retain the safe unbound eager/auto behavior. Do not claim mobile lazy/priority scheduling is applied.
carousel.exportSizeHintNote: Apply each plain size only to its breakpoint. Framer prefixes media conditions during export; a whole responsive sizes list here creates invalid nested media conditions.

home.restriction: Runs only on / and preloads only up to 767.98px; shares exact native hero srcset to avoid duplicate candidates.

verification.reviewType: Read-only mirror of current public HTML/runtime with bounded loading-attribute changes. Checkout and form sending disabled; live stock checks are not part of this image review.

livePageSpeed.conditions: One Lighthouse 13.5.0 lab run per device/page. Mobile emulated Moto G Power with slow 4G. No CrUX field data; results vary between runs.
remaining: Mobile product priority/index override is not forwarded by Framer; images currently retain eager/auto on mobile.
